column3: Lesson two. Decide the when, not just the what.
Jinwoo never wakes up wondering whether he'll train today. The quest just appears. Same task, every day.
Psychologists have a name for building that kind of trigger yourself. An implementation intention. It's a plan in the form: if this happens, then I'll do that.
Like, if I finish lunch, then I'll go for a ten minute walk.
A review that combined ninety four tests, with more than eight thousand people, found that these if then plans had a medium to large effect on actually reaching goals.
And Jinwoo stacks his habits too. In one episode, he does his daily run on the way to a raid.
The point isn't motivation. It's that the decision is already made before the moment arrives.
